sections.title: Player text
sections.body: Hush gathers under the colossal trees: warm windows, lantern branches, low roofs, and paths leading toward a tree-tavern, market stalls, festival noise, and the farms beyond.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Hush gathers under the colossal trees: warm windows, lantern branches, low roofs, and paths leading toward a tree-tavern, market stalls, festival noise, and the farms beyond.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Use Hush as the warm hub for Act 3: a lived-in village, ward boundary, social routes, and all optional detours looping back toward the keeper.

sections.title: GM notes
items: No dead ends: co-op, market, festival, farms, and official sign all loop back here or forward to the keeper route.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "Use this as the hub. From here the party can head to the Co-op, ask locals, visit the market or festival, inspect the farms, or follow directions south when custodian_route is set."
